shoulder_root_l.method: shoulder bone head (d-23 section 2 user decision 2026-09-23): point on the arm tube axis line extended into the torso at x = 0.5 * shoulder.x = +0.1510

shoulder_root_r.method: shoulder bone head (d-23 section 2 user decision 2026-09-23): point on the arm tube axis line extended into the torso at x = 0.5 * shoulder.x = -0.1450

shoulder_l.method: arm-torso junction (d-23 section 2 user decision 2026-09-23): x-slices (step 2 mm) tracked inward from seed x=+0.430; innermost slice where the arm section is still a separate closed loop (next slice merges with torso); point on tube axis line at that x; slice fit r=51.5 mm (first slice with r <= 1.1*r_arm: x=+0.3020, r=51.5 mm; no fillet)

shoulder_r.method: arm-torso junction (d-23 section 2 user decision 2026-09-23): x-slices (step 2 mm) tracked inward from seed x=-0.440; innermost slice where the arm section is still a separate closed loop (next slice merges with torso); point on tube axis line at that x; slice fit r=52.0 mm (first slice with r <= 1.1*r_arm: x=-0.2900, r=52.0 mm; no fillet)

elbow_l.method: 50% of shoulder -> wrist (d-23 section 8 default); point on tube axis line

elbow_r.method: 50% of shoulder -> wrist (d-23 section 8 default); point on tube axis line

wrist_l.method: first slice outward from tube middle with circle-fit r > 1.1*r_arm; slice fit r=56.2 mm; point on tube axis line

wrist_r.method: first slice outward from tube middle with circle-fit r > 1.1*r_arm; slice fit r=58.6 mm; point on tube axis line

hip_l.method: z-slices (step 2 mm) tracked upward from seed z=0.130; last slice before the leg section merges with the torso section; point on tube axis line; slice fit r=57.1 mm

hip_r.method: z-slices (step 2 mm) tracked upward from seed z=0.130; last slice before the leg section merges with the torso section; point on tube axis line; slice fit r=57.3 mm

knee_l.method: 50% of hip -> ankle (d-23 section 8 default); point on tube axis line

knee_r.method: 50% of hip -> ankle (d-23 section 8 default); point on tube axis line

ankle_l.method: first slice downward from tube middle with circle-fit r > 1.1*r_leg; slice fit r=68.3 mm; point on tube axis line

ankle_r.method: first slice downward from tube middle with circle-fit r > 1.1*r_leg; slice fit r=68.1 mm; point on tube axis line

pelvis.method: torso axis x=y=0; z = mean(hip_l.z, hip_r.z) + 0.03 m

spine_01.method: belt top: largest negative step of torso area-radius profile (z-slices 2.5 mm, central loop containing (0,0), step minus local median step) = -6.9 mm between z 0.5765/0.5790; belt bottom (largest positive step +7.7 mm) at z 0.4303

spine_02.method: z = (spine_01.z + head.z) / 2 (d-23 section 2 user decision 2026-09-23). Reference only: max half width (max|x|) of central torso loop, excluding arm band z[0.869,0.982] and belt band z[0.4303,0.5777], is at z 0.5790 (hw=386.0 mm); including belt at z 0.5740 (hw=393.5 mm)

head.method: head box / torso crease: z of minimum front-back radius (median |p| of central-loop points with |x| <= |y|) above spine_02 = 177.9 mm (slope kink of the profile)

grip_r.method: palm sphere: RANSAC sphere (4-point fits, r 40-200 mm, inlier |d-r| < 1 mm, refit on inliers) of SRC_hi verts with x < wrist_r.x (10460 verts, 2830 inliers) -> center (-0.7333,+0.0416,+0.9121) r=100.8 mm rms=0.53 mm; projected on SRC_club_hi PCA major axis (6935 verts, both pieces); axis points to the larger-radius end (club head); sphere-to-axis distance 26.5 mm

foot_tip_l.method: shoe verts (z < ankle z 0.124, x sign side): min-y vertex (z 0.040) projected to z=0

foot_tip_r.method: shoe verts (z < ankle z 0.124, x sign side): min-y vertex (z 0.039) projected to z=0

heel_l.method: shoe verts (z < ankle z 0.124, x sign side): max-y vertex (z 0.038) projected to z=0

heel_r.method: shoe verts (z < ankle z 0.124, x sign side): max-y vertex (z 0.038) projected to z=0
